algorithm.summary: SHA-256 over domain || u16be(len(source)) || PeerId::to_bytes() || u64be(wire sequence number). Binds authenticated GossipSub transport metadata only; the application envelope message_id is deliberately NOT an input (ADR-0004).

vectors.name: zero-seed-peer-sequence-0
vectors.note: Golden re-frozen by ADR-0047; the same value is quoted in PUBSUB.md.

vectors.name: second-peer-sequence-0
vectors.note: Same sequence number, different publisher: the two MUST NOT collide, which is why keying on the envelope ID alone is forbidden.
